title: Faryaad E Sakina
body:
Rokey karti thi ye faryaad sakina' baba
Paani baad aapkey dushwaar hai peena baba
Mujhsey milney ke liye aaye ho ek saal ke baad
Kya na yaad aayi tumhey baali sakina' baba
My zaraa deyr bhi panjo'n pey chalii naa baba
Kheenchta aakey rasan shimr kameena' baba
Oonth se raah mey zaalim ney giraaya mujhko
Dekhiye zaqmi hai kitna mera seena' baba
Aap kehtey they jisey dil ka sukoo'n Jaan e jigar
Usko ab maarta hai shimr kameena', baba
Chotey ruqsaar merey, haath badaa zaalim ka
Socho baad aapkey kya mera hai jeena baba
Kabse rorokey yuhi qaak pey sojaatii hoon
Hai kahaa'n soney ko ab aapka seena' baba
Aap maarey gaye, my qaidi bani, shaam chalii
Raas aaya na moharram ka maheena' baba
Zaqmi sarr dekh ke pehchaan lo haalat meri
Khoon hai yaa ke hai maathey pey paseena' baba
Khoon kaano'n se merey paav talak Jaa pahuncha
Shimr bey rehmi se jab baaliyaa'n cheena baba
Aapka naam liya jab bhi, tamaachey khaayi
Tumpey roney ki ijaazat bhi milii naa baba
Laut'tey ghar ko parindo'n pey nazar jab bhi gayii
Yaad aaya hai bohat mujhko madeena' baba
Aapkey sookhey labo'n par Jo chadii dekhi thi
Tabsey beykaar huwa mera ye jeena baba
Khaid khaaney mey bapaa hogaya maatam *"Gaazi"*
Jabkey qaamosh huwi kehkey sakina' baba
